access_gate: Run only AFTER every primary, secondary and enabled auxiliary final profile is complete and source-bound. Validate all six joint locks, prospectively bound input/manifest/protocol hashes and all complete states before ANY trace/frame array loading. Never load H5, environment, neural model/checkpoint or fit a model.

showcase.case_selection: The FIRST admitted final case per condition: minimum(source_episode,source_step,case_id) from frozen case metadata. Both endpoints use the same four source IDs. No success/violation/actions/progress field enters selection; no case substitution or outcome ranking.

overlay_semantics.executed: Black line joins actual saved native body states; triangle is initial state. No imagined rollout or fitted path.
overlay_semantics.goal: Green original physical goal marker/disc16px; original task definition unchanged.
overlay_semantics.body: Blue endpoint disc shows protected body radius7px at the last saved executed state.
overlay_semantics.hazard: Filled red circle uses the actual frozen virtual-hazard centre/radius. No hazard in the none condition.
overlay_semantics.margin: Dashed r+7+3 envelope marks the requested body-centre clearance around the actual virtual hazard.
overlay_semantics.planning_allowance: Separately dotted r+7+3+12.405431747436523 buffer illustrates the learned checker allowance for PREDICTED body centres. It is empirical, separate from observed executed clearance, and not a certified safety bound.
overlay_semantics.selected_targets: Observed-memory target XY markers are separate from the executed path. When an original visual goal was selected, the plotted diamond is the logged frozen-readout XY estimate, explicitly labelled as an estimate.
overlay_semantics.proposed: Grey native-command glyphs use8displaypixels per native action unit at at most4deterministically spaced actions. These are command glyphs, not predicted next states or executed displacements.
overlay_semantics.policy_images: All overlays are analysis-only. Stored policy-input frames and goal images are never modified, redrawn, synthesized or fed back to the controller.

metrics: For every one of48fixed showcase arm/case/endpoint rows, export frozen SC/V/unfinished/engagement, actual executed actions, episode/planning time and explicit encoder/cost/safety/readout/predictor work fields. Never add query aliases together; the figure WM label means cost-call attempts.

raw_video.pair_selection: The fixed pair applies to all four preselected cases and both endpoints, regardless of outcomes.
raw_video.dependencies: Use only already-installed ffmpeg/Pillow and lossless RGB libx264rgb. Skip with recorded reason if unavailable; do not install dependencies.
raw_video.frame_integrity: Copy each saved224x224uint8 frame unchanged into a side-by-side canvas. Put labels in an added header outside the original frames. Hold the last recorded frame after termination; annotate playback as10fps, not simulation time. No image overlays/edits/generation.

evidence: Record media/analysis/input/manifest/source hashes, all complete final profile state/source-freeze/protocol and episode metadata hashes, every selected trace/selector-history hash and original prepared-input hash. Verify selected-target history against its episode provenance. Export every output hash.
claims: Illustrative fixed-source scientific media only. No selection of a favorable repeat/case/baseline from final outcomes and no optimizer-superiority inference from showcase trajectories. The separately frozen analysis remains the quantitative result.

synthetic_renderer_qualification.renderer_change: No rendering or showcase-selection change. Only frozen analysis-v3 dependency, relocated host readiness and relocation/proof input-hash provenance changed. Both dummy4x6 PNG/SVG exports preserve read-only inputs. Prior renderer visual QA remains applicable.

amendment_rule: Preserve this source/plan after final outcomes. Any necessary pre-outcome correction uses a new version and records its reason.
amendment_reason: Availability-driven actual-host/deadline continuation only. Original Nav repeat0 and first admitted case per condition remain fixed; every original main/aux profile and exact continuation authority must validate before arrays. Restore original showcase evidence outside canonical results only after own-host accounting.
